assertions.assertion: States that with server-side sessions the cookie carries only the session id, not tokens
assertions.rationale: It states the cookie holds only a random session identifier and no claims or tokens.

assertions.assertion: States that all tokens, including refresh tokens, are stored server-side in the session store
assertions.rationale: It says the access, ID, and refresh tokens are all stored server-side, not in the cookie.

assertions.assertion: Explains the in-memory store is lost on process restart and not shared across instances (users appear logged out on a different node)
assertions.rationale: It explains the in-memory store is not durable (wiped on restart) and not shared between nodes, causing random logouts across instances.

assertions.assertion: Recommends a persistent, shared store for multi-node BFF via Duende.BFF.EntityFramework / AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions
assertions.rationale: It recommends a generic shared persistent store (SQL/Redis) but does not name Duende.BFF.EntityFramework or AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions.
